subject: SKU consolidation + support uplift options — legal redline sensitivity
messages:
From: Mark Levin <mark.levin@medictech.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Perez <sara.perez@medictech.com>, procurement@medictech.com
Date: Mon, 1 Dec 2025 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Consolidating SKUs and support uplift — initial ask

Mina,

Thanks for the demo last week — MedicTech liked the performance benchmarks on medium-length clinical workflows. Procurement asked me to confirm a couple of things before we progress to procurement/legal:

1) SKU consolidation: we currently have separate SKUs for site license, operator seats, and burst nodes. Can Redwood provide a single, simplified SKU construct (one invoice line) for our PrivDeploy (air-gapped) rollout?

2) Platform fee amortization: we’d prefer the platform fee amortized monthly over the first 36 months rather than an upfront platform charge.

3) Support uplift: we need an Enhanced Support tier that includes quarterly security reviews, 24x5 phone support, and a SOC2 evidence package — please attach the delta pricing.

4) Legal: our legal team flagged that we want minimal redlines to the standard addendum. If price or fee structure changes trigger new clauses, please call that out — legal is sensitive to any non-standard warranties/escrow terms.

I’ve attached our procurement form and a first-pass SOW for the pilot. Can we get a short written options summary + ballpark numbers by EOD Wednesday so procurement can prioritize?

Mark
Director of Cloud Ops
MedicTech

Attachments: MedicTech_SOW_v1.pdf; Procurement_Form.xlsx

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Mark Levin <mark.levin@medictech.com>
Cc: Sara Perez <sara.perez@medictech.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Dec 2025 13:40:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Consolidating SKUs and support uplift — initial ask

Mark — thanks, and glad the demo was useful. High level reply below; I’ll pull finance/solutions numbers and follow up with a short options table tomorrow.

Quick answers:
- SKU consolidation: yes — we can map your inventory to a single invoiceable SKU for PrivDeploy that covers operator seats + standard node entitlement. We’ll produce an appendix that shows the mapping (operator-to-node equivalence). That SKU will be billing-friendly (monthly metered or fixed monthly amortized).

- Platform fee amortization: we can amortize the platform fee monthly over 36 months for billing. Net effect is the same ARR for Redwood; we can show 36-month, 24-month, and upfront tables.

- Support uplift: three standard support tiers available — Standard (email, 9x5), Enhanced (24x5 phone + quarterly security review + SOC2 evidence bundle), and Enterprise (SRE retainer + on-call rotation options). I’ll include delta pricing for Enhanced vs Standard. Enhanced includes a dedicated TAM for quarterly reviews.

- Legal sensitivity: understood. Any change to the commercial structure that creates non-standard indemnity/escrow asks will be surfaced. If you prefer Redwood’s addendum with a small commercial appendix, that’s our recommended route to avoid protracted redlines.

Action: I’ve attached a draft SKU_mapping_draft.xlsx and will circulate three pricing scenarios (amortized 36m, amortized 24m, upfront) + a one-pager describing the Enhanced support SLOs and what triggers the SOC2 evidence delivery.

Can we do a 30-minute call Wednesday 11:00am PT to walk the procurement team through the options?

Best,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SKU_mapping_draft.xlsx

From: Mark Levin <mark.levin@medictech.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Perez <sara.perez@medictech.com>, procurement@medictech.com
Date: Tue, 2 Dec 2025 10:10:05 -0800
Subject: Re: Consolidating SKUs and support uplift — initial ask

Mina — thanks for the quick note. A few clarifications from procurement/legal:

- Amortization works for us if you can provide month-by-month invoice samples and the amortized schedule is fixed for the term (no retroactive changes).

- For the Enhanced Support tier, we need: a defined quarterly security review scope, SLA for SOC2 artifact turnaround (max 5 business days), and named contact for TAM escalation. Can you confirm those in writing?

- Legal: we want to avoid escrow unless strictly necessary. If Redwood is able to accept a limited warranty clause and liability cap that’s aligned to the fees, that will be sufficient.

We’re happy to take the Wednesday call — 11:00am PT works. Please include your finance/contract rep on the call so we can accelerate.

Mark

To: Mark Levin <mark.levin@medictech.com>, Sara Perez <sara.perez@medictech.com>, procurement@medictech.com
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Dec 2025 17:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Consolidating SKUs and support uplift — options + MAP

Team — following the call today, looping in David (Sales Lead) and Marissa (Finance) to lock numbers. Below is a concise mutual action plan (MAP) and three pricing scenarios — attached is a spreadsheet (pricing_scenarios.csv) and a draft MAP doc (MAP_v1.docx).

Summary of options (monthly amounts shown are illustrative; see attached CSV for line-by-line):

Option A — Amortized platform fee (36 months) + Consolidated SKU (recommended pilot)
- Platform fee amortized monthly: $12,500/mo (36 months)
- Consolidated PrivDeploy SKU (covers operator + base nodes): $24,000/mo (metered to peak)
- Enhanced Support uplift: $6,000/mo (includes quarterly security review, 24x5 phone, SOC2 evidence within 5 business days)
- One-time pilot setup: $18,000 (engineer time)

Option B — Amortized 24 months (higher monthly platform fee)
- Platform fee amortized: $16,000/mo (24 months)
- Consolidated SKU: $24,000/mo
- Enhanced Support uplift: $6,000/mo
- Pilot setup: $18,000

Option C — Upfront platform fee (single payment) + discounted SKU
- Platform fee upfront: $360,000 (one-time)
- Consolidated SKU (5% discount): $22,800/mo
- Enhanced Support uplift: $6,000/mo

Key contract notes for legal:
- Redwood prefers to keep commercial changes in an appendix to the standard addendum to avoid changing core warranty/indemnity language.
- We can accept a limited liability cap tied to the annualized fees; escrow requests will need executive approval.
- SOC2 artifact turnaround: committed to 5 business days for the standard evidence bundle; ad-hoc artifacts may require longer windows documented in the SOW.

MAP (high level):
- Dec 4: Redwood sends finalized pricing CSV and a one-page appendix draft (action: Mina)
- Dec 6: MedicTech legal provides any focused redlines to appendix (action: Mark)
- Dec 8: Finance alignment and PO intent (action: Marissa + Mark)
- Dec 15: Target pilot start (action: Engineering onboarding)

Open items for product/engineering: please confirm that air-gapped (airgap) install for PrivDeploy supports the SOC2 evidence collection workflow and quarterly security review cadence. If product needs a manifest of what we collect from customer in airgap mode, list that in the SOW appendix.

David/Marissa — please confirm the attached CSV pricing bands and whether we can offer a 5% one-time migration credit if MedicTech signs a 36-month commitment. If yes, I will reflect that in Option A.

Mark — thanks again; if the pilot economics look good we’ll prepare the appendix for a quick approval path.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
